name: Sports Reporter (the "Blue Sheet")
kind: Football, basketball and baseball betting newsletter publisher with a VIP picks service
title: Sports Reporter Review 2026: Pricing, Record, Is It Worth It?
description: Sports Reporter review, checked 17 Nov 2026: membership prices from $10.95 a day to $1,195 VIP, cancel terms, the record question and what bettors say.
dek: A betting newsletter founded in 1975 and nicknamed the Blue Sheet, now online only and edited by Bobby Smith. Online access costs $10.95 a day to $249.95 a year, and a six month VIP picks package costs $1,195. The site publishes no running record. The only outside numbers are a forum member's partial tallies of its Best Bets, near even over the seasons we found.

short_answer: Sports Reporter is a real, long running publication. Its site names the company (Sound Sporting Ventures, LLC), a mailing address, a phone line with hours and a full price list, and it posts free sample issues. It says it was founded in 1975 and now publishes only online: the weekly Sports Reporter for NFL and college football, a Friday Midweek Update, and a Daily Brief for baseball and basketball. It moved from sportsreporter.com to sportsreporter.net in 2026.

What it does not publish is a record. We found no win and loss history for its Best Bets, Recommended plays or the VIP Premier Players picks on any page we read. The only outside numbers come from a TheRX member who graded its Best Bets at the printed line: 45-39-2 in the 2022 season through 16 Jan 2023 (53.6%), and 20-21-1 in 2024 through 28 Oct. After a complaint from Sports Reporter in Sep 2025 the forum stopped posting the paper, so there is no outside tally since.
As a well written research paper at $39.95 for 30 days it may be worth a look; read the free samples first. Paying $1,195 for the VIP picks means trusting a record nobody publishes.

guarantee: We found no guarantee, refund or credit policy on any Sports Reporter page we read, old site or new. Nothing promises money back for losing picks.

To cancel, the privacy policy on the new site says: "To Cancel Subscription Sportsreporter.net gives users the following option to no longer receive our service. You can call the following telephone number: 1-855-305-9604." The old site's legal page gives a different number, 1-800-305-9604, and the December 2025 sample issue prints both numbers on different pages. We did not call either number.

The December 2025 sample issue also told readers to call when they want to renew, because "Online renewal transactions have been experiencing technical difficulties." The old site's signup form now reads "There are no products available for purchase."

claims_note: Sports Reporter grades its selections as Best Bets and Recommended, and the VIP service uses star ratings up to 5 Stars and higher. None of the pages we read gives a season record for any of these tiers, so a buyer has no seller record to hold the paper to.
The price claims do add up: $39.95 for 30 days is the "$1.33/day" the samples page advertises, and $249.95 for a year is under $1 a day as stated.
record: Watchdog search, 22 Nov 2026: we searched about 1.37 million captured public posts from X, Reddit, Covers, TheRX and other forums for Sports Reporter plays that were posted or reposted before a game started. We found 30 posts naming Sports Reporter, but none carried a play we could match to a game and grade.

What the seller publishes: no record that we could find. The weekly paper prints a forecast margin, a final score prediction and Best Bet or Recommended labels for every game, and the samples page offers free sample issues, but no page lists past results for those labels.

What outsiders tallied: a TheRX member grades many newsletters at the line printed in each paper. For Sports Reporter's college and NFL Best Bets that tally read 17-16 and 9-7 through 31 Oct 2021; 33-20 and 12-19-2 through 16 Jan 2023, a combined 45-39-2 (53.6%) for the 2022 season; and 15-11 and 5-10-1 through 28 Oct 2024, a combined 20-21-1 (48.8%). By our math, that is above break even at -110 for 2022 and below it for the 2024 stretch. The tally listed no Super Best Bets in those seasons. We did not check these numbers against the papers.

In Sep 2025 the thread's regular poster said TheRX had received a complaint from Sports Reporter and could no longer post it. The same member's 2026 tally, through 9 Nov 2026, lists Sports Reporter at 0-0-0 in every category, so there is no outside count for this season. We found no contest results and no regulator or court record in our searches.

our_data.text: In this edition no Sports Reporter pick is matched to a Watchdog graded record, so we make no claim about how Sports Reporter performs.

customers_intro: Independent buyer evidence is thin and comes from two forums. On TheRX the paper was shared and graded weekly until 2025; on Sportsbook Review one long time reader commented on it in 2020. We found no review site sample we could count, and our Reddit search was partial because the archive we use kept timing out.

customers.text: We found about eight relevant posts on Sportsbook Review and TheRX from 2020 to 2025, and no buyer reviews of the VIP picks. TheRX members regularly asked for new issues in late 2022 and early 2023. The one opinion of the writing came from a long time newsletter reader on Sportsbook Review in 2020, who reads it but doubts its editor's handicapping. A TheRX member's tally of its Best Bets came out a little above break even in the 2022 season and a little below it over part of 2024. In Sep 2025 the forum stopped posting the paper after a complaint from Sports Reporter.

A Sportsbook Review member who said they had read football newsletters for decades listed Sports Reporter among the papers they read, but wrote that its editor is not as good a handicapper as he thinks he is.
A TheRX member's newsletter tally through 31 Oct 2021 had Sports Reporter's college Best Bets at 17-16 and NFL Best Bets at 9-7, graded at the printed line. We did not verify it.

The same tally through 16 Jan 2023 had the 2022 season's college Best Bets at 33-20 and NFL Best Bets at 12-19-2. On the same page members asked for and thanked others for the latest Sports Reporter issue.
A TheRX member asked whether anyone had that week's Sports Reporter.
The TheRX tally through 28 Oct 2024 had Sports Reporter's college Best Bets at 15-11 and NFL Best Bets at 5-10-1.
Asked why a different paper was missing, the thread's regular poster said nothing was banned, but that TheRX had received a complaint from Sports Reporter, so the forum could no longer post it.

We found no Better Business Bureau profile we could confirm, no app store listing and no customer testimonials on the Sports Reporter pages we read. Our Reddit search was partial: the archive's full text search timed out, and our saved Reddit posts held no discussion of Sports Reporter.

conflicts: We found no sportsbook links, promo codes or partner pickers on the Sports Reporter pages we read, which matches its "No Kickbacks" statement. We cannot see its contracts.
The publisher also sells a book, How to Beat the Pro Football Pointspread, linked from the Meet the Publisher page. That is a related product, not a conflict with betting outcomes.
strengths: A named company, a mailing address, a phone line with posted hours and a full price list.
Free sample issues of the weekly paper, the Midweek Update and the Daily Brief, so you can judge the writing before paying.
Low entry price: $10.95 for one day or $39.95 for 30 days of all papers.
States it has no sportsbook affiliation, and we saw no sportsbook promotion on its pages.
concerns: No published record for Best Bets, Recommended plays or the $1,195 VIP picks.
No refund or guarantee terms found; cancellation is by phone, and two different phone numbers appear across its pages.
Online renewal problems were acknowledged in a December 2025 issue, and the old site still carries outdated claims and a signup form with nothing for sale.
The only outside tally, by a forum member, was near break even: 53.6% in 2022 and 48.8% over part of 2024, and there is none since 2025.
checklist: Ask for every pick from the last 12 months with the line, the odds and the time it was sent. A list of hot runs is not a record.
Count units, not wins. A 60% record at heavy favorites can still lose money.
Read the guarantee for the words refund, credit and extension. Most "guarantees" in this business are credits.
Write down each pick yourself the moment you receive it, with the line you can actually get.
Give any handicapper a few hundred picks before you call them a winner. Short runs swing hard both ways.
faq: It is a real, long running newsletter run by Sound Sporting Ventures, LLC in Bayville, New York, with a phone line, published prices and free samples. It says it was founded in 1975. We could not verify that its picks win, because it publishes no record of them.
How much does Sports Reporter cost?
On 17 Nov 2026 online access was $10.95 for a day, $39.95 for 30 days, $189.95 for six months and $249.95 for a year. The SR VIP package with Premier Players picks was $1,195 for six months.
Does Sports Reporter have a verified record?
No. We found no record on its pages. A TheRX member's tally of its Best Bets at the printed lines was 45-39-2 for the 2022 season and 20-21-1 for 2024 through 28 Oct, and that tally stopped in 2025.
How do I cancel Sports Reporter?
Its privacy policy says to call 1-855-305-9604. The old site lists 1-800-305-9604. Phone hours are Monday to Friday, 9 am to 5 pm ET, and the contact page says it is occasionally closed Wednesdays.
What do you get with a Sports Reporter membership?

Online PDF access to the weekly Sports Reporter (23 football issues, August to February), the Friday Midweek Update (21 issues) and the Daily Brief for baseball and basketball, plus bonus horse racing content on Triple Crown and Breeders' Cup days. The VIP package adds star rated game day picks.

As reading material it is cheap to try at $10.95 a day, and its samples show full written forecasts for every game. As a pick service it is unproven: no record is published, and the one outside tally was close to break even.
